Safety & Responsible AI HEALTH-A-THON 2026  •  FINAL SUBMISSION 🔒 Data Privacy ⚠️ AI Limitations 👁️ Human Oversight • OCR → UNVERIFIED facts • Hallucinations → source checks • RAG mismatch → doctor review AI suggests Nurse reviews Doctor verifies Flagged cases → doctor Corrections → knowledge base NON-NEGOTIABLE SAFETY RULES 🚫 AI NEVER diagnoses, prescribes, or scores risk. 🚫 Human confirmation before record finalization. 🚫 Detected danger signs → 0% match confidence → doctor. ♿ Hindi/Marathi voice: in progress • Large buttons • Low-end phones • Offline OCR; cloud AI/voice online • Consent before digitization • SQLite + cloud AI processing • Redaction + training: verify 🔒 NFC band stores ONLY a unique link — no medical data on the band 🔒 Band is useless without hospital scanner + authenticated portal 🔒 Patient App shows ONLY their own data — no cross-patient access ♿ ₹50 band — affordable for all economic backgrounds ♿ NFC = no literacy needed — just tap
